title: What opens first: the big picture or what needs you?

options.label: "Needs you" when there's something; the overview when there isn't
options.act: Landing = needs-you if open cards, else overview
options.then: Open on Needs you when anything waits, and on the overview when nothing does.

why: What needs you, when something does; the overview when nothing does. If cards are waiting, you're there to decide, so the board opens on them (Linear Inbox). At zero it opens on the overview, which reads like an achievement rather than an empty list (the Flex design's inbox-zero screen). Either is one key away.
